data.help:
igdev is the Ignition local-development toolchain: one global binary that
owns the engine and the Ignition domain knowledge, while each repository keeps only a
thin tracked Project Contract (igdev.toml) plus disposable local state in .igdev/.

Lifecycle verbs: init creates the Project Contract, setup materializes this checkout.
Every project command first passes the Gate: discover Project Root, validate contract
schema, validate Setup Stamp, check command prerequisites.

Agent usage: pass --json for the machine contract. stdout is then a single JSON
envelope {ok, contract, code, message, remediation, data}; progress and notices go to
stderr. Exit levels are 0 success, 1 command failure, 2 usage error, 3 human action
required. With every argument supplied igdev runs in Silent Mode: it never prompts.

Contract: 1

Usage:
  igdev [flags]
  igdev [command]

Available Commands:
  baseline    Stage and report the Gateway backup this checkout restores from
  build       Run the project's declared build stage, then re-stage the modules
  catalog     Inspect the capability knowledge the CLI resolves against
  check       Run the fixed preflight pipeline before anything else
  ci-local    Run this project's GitHub Actions workflows locally through act
  completion  Print the shell completion script for igdev
  doctor      Audit the host prerequisites igdev's runtime work depends on
  gateway     Control this Instance's Ignition Gateway
  help        Show help for a command
  init        Create or edit the Project Contract (igdev.toml)
  jython      Compile project code with the pinned Jython compatibility checker
  module      List modules and check what project code requires
  setup       Materialize this checkout: Instance identity, ports, runtime files
  status      Report project, setup, and effective config state
  test        Run the project's declared test stage
  verify      Run check, test, and build in sequence
  version     Print the CLI version and the CLI Contract Version

Flags:
      --config stringArray   override one config key for this run, key=value (highest precedence)
  -h, --help                 help for igdev
      --json                 emit the JSON envelope on stdout (machine mode)

Use "igdev [command] --help" for more information about a command.
